integrity: All equations, quantifiers, and asymptotic rates are derived from bounded Hardy multipliers and integrable q-series limits. Computations are corroboration only; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers Hardy-space atomic kernels only; no optimality of similarity under arbitrary nonunit eigenvector rescalings is claimed; publication-priority uncertainty persists for older weighted-composition/q-series literature. Infinite identities are established by proof, not finite test.
title: Sharp spectral conditioning of atomic Bergman-kernel dilations on Hardy space
